speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever after recent antibiotic treatment. Can you describe the nature of the flank pain—is it constant, colicky, or does it radiate anywhere? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as frequency, burning, or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any pain or burning when you urinate, and have you noticed any blood in your urine? I also need to know if you have any nausea, vomiting, or chills accompanying these symptoms.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you notice any joint pain, swelling, or dark-colored urine while you had the rash? I am concerned this could be serum sickness or acute interstitial nephritis triggered by the antibiotics.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any current swelling in your legs or face, or shortness of breath? I need to assess for potential renal involvement or fluid overload. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
